query:
WITH RECURSIVE reach(id) AS (
               SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE number = ?1
               UNION
               SELECT d.needs_task_id FROM dependencies d JOIN reach r ON d.task_id = r.id
           )
           SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM reach r JOIN tasks t ON t.id = r.id WHERE t.number = ?2
           ) AS "reached!: bool"
